tooltips.kind: How this run was triggered: 'customer-message' (a contact sent a message that the AI replied to) or 'followup-trigger' (a scheduled follow-up fired without an inbound message).
tooltips.agent: The AI agent membership that produced this run.
tooltips.conversation: The conversation this run engaged with.
tooltips.tenant: Denormalized tenant of the run's parent ChatwootAccount. Set automatically; used for per-tenant reports and ACL-free aggregations.
tooltips.triggerMessageId: The Chatwoot message id that triggered the run; empty for follow-up runs.
tooltips.triggerMessageAt: Wall-clock time the triggering Chatwoot message was created (T0 for lead-time). Empty for follow-up runs.
tooltips.runAt: Wall-clock time the run finished and emitted the agent_completed event.
tooltips.durationMs: Run wall-clock time in milliseconds (start of streamText to end of the final step).
tooltips.leadTimeMs: End-to-end lead time in milliseconds: from when the customer message was received in Chatwoot (triggerMessageAt) to when the agent run completed (runAt). Includes webhook dispatch + queue wait + agent compute. Empty for follow-up runs.
tooltips.stepCount: Number of model invocation steps within this run.
tooltips.toolsUsed: Distinct tool names called during the run.
tooltips.inputTokens: Total input/prompt tokens consumed by the run.
tooltips.outputTokens: Total output/completion tokens produced by the run.
tooltips.totalTokens: Total tokens (input + output, as reported by the provider).
tooltips.cachedInputTokens: Subset of input tokens served from the implicit-context cache.
tooltips.model: LLM identifier used for this run (e.g. gemini-3-flash-preview).
tooltips.wasTransferred: True if the run invoked the transfer tool.
tooltips.hadAppointment: True if the run invoked the appointments tool.
tooltips.createdOpportunity: True if the run invoked the create_opportunity tool at least once. Path 3 split — supersedes the legacy hadOpportunity union flag; query the OR of the three per-action flags when you need 'any opportunity activity'.
tooltips.updatedOpportunity: True if the run invoked the update_opportunity tool at least once.
tooltips.deletedOpportunity: True if the run invoked the delete_opportunity tool at least once.
tooltips.sentFollowupMessage: True if the run invoked the send_followup_message tool — i.e. the AI agent actually emitted a follow-up message rather than terminating via a deliberate opportunity update (Ended / ActionNeeded) or a silent-done failure. Always false on customer-message runs (the tool is only registered on the follow-up arm).
tooltips.hatchetEventId: UUID of the originating Hatchet `chatwoot://agent_completed` event in the v1_events_olap table. Use it to cross-reference this row with Hatchet's UI / logs / REST API. Always set for backfilled rows; populated by the live consumer via a per-run REST lookup of event.list({workflowRunIds:[ctx.workflowRunId()]}).
